item.title: Old Gods of Appalachia: Return to the Darkest Hills
item.description: Step into the alternate Appalachia of the Old Gods. Download the complete Cypher System horror roleplaying game collection from Monte Cook Games, including the core rulebook, character options, and haunting adventures.

item.title: Check out this awesome new ‘Alien: Romulus’ poster art by 12sketches
item.description: If you love xenomorphs, this pretty gnarly new poster art by 12sketches could be for you

item.title: Watch ‘Playing God’, the dark and incredibly powerful 9-minute stop-motion animation short
item.description: I was lucky enough to stumble upon Playing God, and having now watched this strange yet beautifully done stop-motion animation, I felt compelled to share it. The 9-minute short from Matteo Burani and Arianna Gheller took seven years to make, and goes all-in with the idea of creating self-aware beings out of clay – something […]

item.title: What’s Your Game 2026 raises a glass with new headline sponsor: The Afon Mêl Mead Hall
item.description: What’s Your Game 2026 is moving to Gloucester's GL1 Leisure Centre. Discover the dates, the new Afon Mêl Mead Hall sponsor, and what it means for UK LARP fans.

item.title: Origins Award finalist announces polycule-friendly RPG Threads We Share
item.description: Eerie Games announces Threads We Share, a GMless tarot TTRPG about relationships, intimacy, and consent. Supports solo, duet, and polycule play.

item.title: The Dread Thingonomicon: Salvation for the Overworked GM
item.description: Struggling with session prep? The Dread Thingonomicon Bundle offers 476 pages of system-neutral lists to help overworked GMs add instant detail to any fantasy RPG.

item.title: Onyx Path turns 15: Big sales, Curseborne in print, and a look ahead
item.description: Onyx Path Publishing celebrates 15 years with a massive "New Year, New Game" sale on DriveThruRPG and updates on Curseborne, Pugmire, and Storypath Ultra.

item.title: Fanatical drops a critical hit: 77 Dungeon Crawl Classics RPG books for under $18
item.description: Get 77 TTRPG adventures for $17.99. Goodman Games and Fanatical team up for the Colossal 70+ Dungeons RPG Collection. Redeemable on DriveThruRPG.

item.title: Hands-on with LEGO’s smart play: Star Wars sets get a digital brain
item.description: LEGO announces the Smart Play system at CES 2026, featuring sensor-packed bricks that react to movement and minifigures without a screen.

item.title: Ships of the Shattered Empire brings mass combat to Genesys this Friday
item.description: Ships of the Shattered Empire arrives Jan 9 for Genesys RPG. The 208-page book adds ship profiles and setting-agnostic mass combat rules.
